pages.text: Points to your own nearest totem, however far. Load it with Shatter Coins and start tracking, and for a while it points to the nearest rival totem within its reach instead.$(br2)After tracking it needs to cool down. Upgrades shorten the cooldown.

A compass finds rival totems only within its $(l)reach$(): 100 blocks from you across the ground and 10 above or below, at first.$(br2)$(l)WIDER$() and $(l)DEEPER$() on its screen buy more, up to 2,500 and 150. The upgrades stay with that compass.
pages.title: Reach

pages.text: With no rival totem in reach giving off enough $(l:totem/radiation)radiation$(), the needle spins and the screen says so.$(br2)Pips on the compass in your hotbar count its upgrades: turquoise along the bottom for across, gold up the side for up or down.
